headlines.title: 工信部：前5个月规模以上工业企业营业收入利润率5.66%，为2024年以来月度累计最高水平
headlines.summary: 国务院新闻办公室举行新闻发布会，介绍2026年上半年工业和信息化发展情况。工业和信息化部总工程师王卫明表示，上半年工业生产稳定增长，规模以上工业增加值同比增长5.4%，41个工业大类行业当中有32个保持增长，工业企业盈利能力持续改善。前5个月规模以上工业企业营业收入利润率5.66%， 为2024年以来月度累计最高水平。全球人工智能绿色低碳转型等需求旺盛。上半年以人民币计价的集成电路、电子元件、风力发电机组等产品，出口额同比分别增长88.7%，62.6%和35.6%。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: Profit margin of industrial enterprises above designated size in first 5 months at 5.66%, the highest monthly cumulative level since 2024
headlines.summary_en: At a press conference by the State Council Information Office on industrial and information technology development in the first half of 2026, Wang Weiming, Chief Engineer of MIIT, said industrial production grew steadily with value-added industrial output above designated size up 5.4% year-on-year. Among 41 major industrial categories, 32 saw growth, and corporate profitability continued to improve. In the first five months, the profit margin of industrial enterprises above designated size was 5.66%, the highest cumulative monthly level since 2024. Global demand for AI and green low-carbon transition was strong. In the first half, exports of integrated circuits, electronic components, and wind turbines in RMB terms grew 88.7%, 62.6%, and 35.6%, respectively.

headlines.title: 工信部：将印发算力标准体系建设指南，推动建立算力市场化定价等标准
headlines.summary: 国务院新闻办公室举行新闻发布会，介绍2026年上半年工业和信息化发展情况。工业和信息化部新闻发言人、信息通信发展司司长谢存表示，下一步工信部将持续按照点、链、网、面、体系化工作思路，优化算力基础设施资源部署，打造算力互联互通节点，提升算力资源利用效率。在点上发力方面，将优化算力资源供给部署，统筹产业发展和能源供给等因素，推动智算集群建设和算电协同发展，打造梯次化算力布局，加强算力统筹监测。此外，将印发算力标准体系建设指南，推动建立算力服务能力评估、算力市场化定价等标准。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: To issue computing power standards system construction guidelines, promote the establishment of market-based pricing standards for computing power
headlines.summary_en: At a press conference by the State Council Information Office on industrial and information technology development in the first half of 2026, Xie Cun, spokesperson for MIIT and Director of the Information and Communications Development Department, said MIIT will optimize computing infrastructure resource deployment, create interconnected computing nodes, and improve computing resource utilization efficiency. This includes promoting intelligent computing cluster construction and computing-power coordination, and drafting guidelines for a computing power standard system, including assessments and market pricing standards.

headlines.title: 中石油集团获证监会批准成为英大期货实控人
headlines.summary: 证监会最新消息显示，英大期货获批变更股权、实控人，此次变更后，英大期货成为中国石油集团资本有限责任公司成为的全资子公司，出资额仍为6.58亿元，公司实际控制人变更为中国石油天然气集团有限公司。英大期货仍需依法办理变更登记等相关事宜。早在去年12月，国网英大曾宣布，全资子公司英大证券拟将所持英大期货100%股权，以11.29亿元的价格出售给中油资本，今年1月，国务院国资委同意此次股权出售。

headlines.title_en: CNPC Group receives CSRC approval to become actual controller of Yingda Futures
headlines.summary_en: The CSRC announced that Yingda Futures has received approval for a change in equity and actual controller. After the change, Yingda Futures becomes a wholly-owned subsidiary of CNPC Capital, with the same registered capital of 658 million yuan, and the actual controller becomes China National Petroleum Corporation. Yingda Futures must still handle registration procedures. Last December, State Grid Yingda announced that its subsidiary Yingda Securities would sell all 100% of Yingda Futures to CNPC Capital for 1.129 billion yuan, and the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission approved the sale this January.

headlines.title: 工信部：将印发实施工信领域行业、专题“十五五”规划
headlines.summary: 工业和信息化部总工程师王卫明在国新办新闻发布会上表示，当前外部环境复杂严峻，国内供强需弱、结构性矛盾仍然突出，但我国产业体系全、韧性强的优势明显，各项改革举措和支持政策持续发力，工业经济发展稳中向好的基本面没有改变。下一步，我们将聚焦高质量发展这一首要任务，更好统筹发展和安全，印发实施工信领域行业、专题“十五五”规划，加快构建以先进制造业为骨干的现代化产业体系，不断提升工业经济运行质效，保持工业和信息化经济平稳发展，实现“十五五”良好开局。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: To issue and implement industry and thematic '15th Five-Year Plan' for MIIT sectors
headlines.summary_en: Wang Weiming, Chief Engineer of MIIT, said at a press conference that while the external environment is complex and severe, and domestic supply-demand imbalances and structural issues persist, China's complete industrial system and strong resilience provide advantages. The fundamentals of steady industrial economic development remain unchanged. Next, MIIT will focus on high-quality development, coordinate development and security, issue industry-specific plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan, accelerate building a modern industrial system led by advanced manufacturing, and ensure a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.
